$comment: The single source of truth for page metadata. Imported by the Vue app so it can update the title on client-side navigation, and read by the API so it can inject the same values into the HTML it serves — crawlers and social scrapers that do not execute JavaScript would otherwise see one generic title for all ten pages. It lives in public/ so the build copies it verbatim into wwwroot where the server can find it, and is imported from source as well so the client pays no fetch for it.

routes.title: PdfWerk — PDF operations as an HTTP API
routes.description: Create, edit, merge, split, watermark, protect and summarise PDFs over a plain HTTP API, with a web interface and embeddable widgets on top. Source-available and free to self-host.
routes.heading: PDF operations as an HTTP API
routes.intro: Eleven PDF operations, each one an HTTP endpoint with a matching page in the browser. Per-action rate limits, a free key that takes one request, and a drop-in widget for embedding any of it in your own application.

routes.title: Create a PDF from text or Markdown — free online
routes.description: Turn plain text or Markdown into a paginated PDF in your browser. Choose page size, orientation, margins and page numbering. No signup, no watermark on the output.
routes.heading: Create a PDF from text
routes.intro: Paste or type your content, pick a page size, and get a proper paginated document back. Markdown headings, lists, emphasis and code blocks are laid out for print rather than for a screen.

routes.title: Convert Word to PDF — free, no signup
routes.description: Convert a .docx or .doc file to PDF in your browser. Layout, headings and page breaks are preserved. Nothing is stored after the conversion finishes.
routes.heading: Word to PDF
routes.intro: Upload a Word document and get a PDF back. Where LibreOffice is available the conversion is faithful to the original layout; otherwise a managed converter handles the common cases without it.

routes.title: Edit text in a PDF — find and replace online
routes.description: Find and replace text inside an existing PDF. The original words are removed from the file rather than covered over, so they disappear from search and copy-paste too.
routes.heading: Update text in a PDF
routes.intro: Search for a phrase and replace it throughout the document. Unlike tools that paint a white box over the old text, this rewrites the content stream — so the words you replaced cannot be recovered by selecting or searching the file.

routes.title: Add text to a PDF — write anywhere on a page
routes.description: Click anywhere on a PDF and type. Adds text to blank space, which find and replace cannot do. Free, in the browser, no sign-up.
routes.heading: Update text in a PDF
routes.intro: Search for a phrase and replace it throughout the document. Unlike tools that paint a white box over the old text, this rewrites the content stream — so the words you replaced cannot be recovered by selecting or searching the file.

routes.title: Add form fields to a PDF — fill and flatten online
routes.description: Add, move and remove AcroForm fields on a PDF by clicking the page, then fill them with values or flatten them into the document. Text, checkbox, dropdown, radio and signature fields.
routes.heading: Form fields
routes.intro: Click where a field belongs and it is placed at those exact coordinates in PDF points. Fill the fields with values afterwards, and flatten them when you want the values baked in and the form gone.

routes.title: Merge PDF files — combine documents online
routes.description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you choose. Reorder the list before merging, and download the result immediately. No signup and no watermark.
routes.heading: Merge PDFs
routes.intro: Add two or more documents, drag them into the order you want, and get a single PDF back. Bookmarks and page sizes from each source are carried through.

routes.title: Split, rotate, watermark and password-protect a PDF
routes.description: Extract page ranges, burst a document into single pages, rotate selected pages, stamp a watermark, or encrypt a PDF with a password and permissions.
routes.heading: Page tools
routes.intro: Four operations on the pages themselves. Ranges understand 1-3, odd, even and open-ended tails, so you can take exactly the pages you mean without counting twice.

routes.title: Summarise a PDF with AI — free online
routes.description: Extract the text of a PDF and get an AI summary with key points. Works with Gemini, Groq or a local Ollama model, and long documents are summarised in parts and merged.
routes.heading: Summarise a PDF
routes.intro: The document's text is extracted and sent to a language model. Anything longer than the model's context is split, summarised piecewise and merged, so a two-hundred-page report is handled the same way as a two-page one.

routes.title: Inspect a PDF — page count, metadata and form fields
routes.description: Read a PDF's structure without changing it: page count, page dimensions, title and author, whether it is encrypted, and every form field it contains.
routes.heading: Inspect a PDF
routes.intro: Upload a document to see what is actually inside it — how many pages, what size they are, what metadata it carries, and the name, type and position of every form field.

routes.title: PDF API access and rate limits — PdfWerk
routes.description: Get a free API key in one request. Per-action rate limits, quota headers on every response, and a documented HTTP endpoint behind each tool on the site.
routes.heading: API access
routes.intro: Every tool here is one HTTP call. A free key raises your limits and takes a single request — no account and no email. Each response carries the remaining quota, so you can pace requests instead of discovering the ceiling by being refused.

routes.title: Privacy — PdfWerk
routes.description: What PdfWerk collects and why: documents are processed in memory and never stored, requests are logged with IP addresses to stop abuse, and only the summarise tool sends text to an AI provider.
routes.heading: Privacy
routes.intro: Your documents are processed in memory and never written to disk. Requests are logged with your IP address to stop abuse. Only the summarise tool sends anything to a third party.

routes.title: Terms of use — PdfWerk
routes.description: Use PdfWerk for anything lawful within the published rate limits. Free and provided as-is, source-available under the Business Source License 1.1.
routes.heading: Terms of use
routes.intro: Use it for anything lawful, within the published rate limits. Do not upload documents you have no right to. It is free and provided as-is.

routes.title: Contact PdfWerk
routes.description: Questions about the PDF API, a bug report, or a licensing conversation. Messages reach whoever runs this instance; technical issues are better raised on GitHub.
routes.heading: Get in touch
routes.intro: Questions about the API, a bug, a licensing conversation, or something that should work and does not.

routes.title: Administration — PdfWerk
routes.description: Administrative access to the request log, blocked addresses and rate limits. Requires an administrator key.
